The public type is defined in `crate::types`.\n125\ttype ComplexPackingExtra = ComplexExtra;\n126\t\n127\t// ── Intermediate parsing state accumulated across sections ────────────────────\n128\t\n129\t#[derive(Default)]\n130\tstruct FieldBuilder {\n131\t    // From Section 1\n132\t    center: Option<u16>,\n133\t    subcenter: Option<u16>,\n134\t    ref_time: Option<ReferenceTime>,\n135\t    // From Section 4\n136\t    parameter: Option<ParameterId>,\n137\t    forecast: Option<ForecastTime>,\n138\t    level: Option<Level>,\n139\t    ensemble: Option<Option<Ensemble>>,\n140\t    pdt_template: Option<u16>,\n141\t    // From Section 3\n142\t    grid: Option<GridDefinition>,\n143\t    gdt_template: Option<u16>,\n144\t    // From Section 5\n145\t    packing: Option<PackingInfo>,\n146\t    drt_template: Option<u16>,\n147\t    complex_extra: Option<ComplexPackingExtra>,\n148\t    /// Number of packed data values (Section 5 oct 6-9). Within each\n200\t/// message, repeated section groups (3–7) produce multiple fields.\n201\tpub fn decode_bytes(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<Field>> {\n202\t    let mut fields = Vec::new();\n203\t    let mut pos = 0;\n204\t\n205\t    while pos < bytes.len() {\n206\t        // Peek at next 4 bytes: expect \"GRIB\".\n207\t        if bytes.len() - pos < 4 {\n208\t            break;\n209\t        }\n210\t        if &bytes[pos..pos + 4] != b\"GRIB\" {\n211\t            return Err(Error::BadMagic(bytes[pos..pos + 4].try_into().unwrap()));\n212\t        }\n213\t\n214\t        let msg_len = decode_message(&bytes[pos..], &mut fields)?;\n215\t        pos += msg_len;\n216\t    }\n217\t\n218\t    Ok(fields)\n219\t}\n220\t\n221\t/// Decode one GRIB2 message (starting at byte 0 of `msg`).\n222\t/// Returns the number of bytes consumed (the total message length).\n223\tfn decode_message(msg: &[u8], out: &mut Vec<Field>) -> Result<usize> {\n224\t    let mut buf = Buf::new(msg);\n225\t\n226\t    // ── Section 0 (Indicator, 16 bytes fixed) ────────────────────────────────\n227\t    // oct 1-4: \"GRIB\"\n228\t    let magic = [buf.read_u8()?, buf.read_u8()?, buf.read_u8()?, buf.read_u8()?];\n229\t    if &magic != b\"GRIB\" {\n230\t        return Err(Error::BadMagic(magic));\n231\t    }\n232\t    buf.skip(2)?; // reserved\n233\t    let discipline = buf.read_u8()?;\n234\t    let edition = buf.read_u8()?;\n235\t    if edition != 2 {\n236\t        return Err(Error::UnknownEdition(edition));\n237\t    }\n238\t    let total_len = buf.read_u64be()? as usize;\n239\t    // Section 0 is now consumed (16 bytes).\n240\t\n241\t    // Validate total length against buffer.\n242\t    if msg.len() < total_len {\n243\t        return Err(Error::TooShort { needed: total_len, got: msg.len() });\n244\t    }\n245\t\n246\t    // ── Section iterator (sections 1-7 + \"7777\") ─────────────────────────────\n247\t    let mut builder = FieldBuilder::default();\n248\t\n249\t    // The message body ends just before the \"7777\" end marker.\n250\t    let body_end = total_len - 4;\n251\t\n252\t    while buf.pos < body_end {\n253\t        // Each section starts with: 4-byte length, 1-byte section number.\n254\t        let sec_start = buf.pos;\n255\t        let sec_len = buf.read_u32be()? as usize;\n256\t        let sec_num = buf.read_u8()?;\n257\t\n258\t        if sec_len < 5 {\n259\t            return Err(Error::TooShort { needed: 5, got: sec_len });\n260\t        }\n261\t        // Remaining bytes in this section (after the 5-byte header).\n262\t        let body_start = buf.pos;\n263\t        let body_len = sec_len - 5;\n264\t        let sec_body = &msg[body_start..body_start + body_len];\n265\t\n266\t        match sec_num {\n267\t            1 => {\n268\t                let (center, subcenter, ref_time) = parse_section1(sec_body)?;\n269\t                builder.center = Some(center);\n270\t                builder.subcenter = Some(subcenter);\n271\t                builder.ref_time = Some(ref_time);\n272\t            }\n273\t            2 => { /* Local Use section — skip */ }\n274\t            3 => {\n275\t                let (gdt, grid) = parse_section3(sec_body)?;\n276\t                builder.gdt_template = Some(gdt);\n277\t                builder.grid = Some(grid);\n278\t            }\n279\t            4 => {\n280\t                let (pdt, param, fore, lvl, ens) = parse_section4(sec_body, discipline)?;\n281\t                builder.pdt_template = Some(pdt);\n282\t                builder.parameter = Some(param);\n283\t                builder.forecast = Some(fore);\n284\t                builder.level = Some(lvl);\n285\t                builder.ensemble = Some(ens);\n286\t            }\n287\t            5 => {\n288\t                let (drt, packing, complex_extra, n_packed) = parse_section5(sec_body)?;\n289\t                builder.drt_template = Some(drt);\n290\t                builder.packing = Some(packing);\n291\t                builder.complex_extra = complex_extra;\n292\t                builder.n_packed = Some(n_packed);\n293\t            }\n294\t            6 => {\n295\t                let (has_bitmap, bitmap) = parse_section6(sec_body)?;\n296\t                builder.has_bitmap = Some(has_bitmap);\n297\t                builder.bitmap = bitmap;\n298\t            }\n299\t            7 => {\n300\t                let n_grid = builder.grid.as_ref().map(|g| g.num_data_points as usize).unwrap_or(0);\n301\t                let has_bitmap = builder.has_bitmap.unwrap_or(false);\n302\t                // When a bitmap is present, Section 5 n_packed < n_grid. Use n_packed\n303\t                // for the data unpackers (which only see the \"present\" subset).\n304\t                let n_decode = if has_bitmap {\n305\t                    builder.n_packed.unwrap_or(n_grid)\n306\t                } else {\n307\t                    n_grid\n308\t                };\n309\t                let packing = builder.packing.as_ref().ok_or(Error::NotImplemented)?;\n310\t                let drt = builder.drt_template.unwrap_or(0);\n311\t                let packed_values = decode_section7(\n312\t                    sec_body, packing, drt, builder.complex_extra.as_ref(), n_decode,\n313\t                )?;\n314\t                // Expand packed values into the full grid using the bitmap (if present).\n315\t                let values = if has_bitmap {\n316\t                    expand_bitmap(packed_values, &builder.bitmap, n_grid)\n317\t                } else {\n318\t                    packed_values\n319\t                };\n320\t                builder.values = Some(values);\n321\t\n322\t                // Complete field — flush the builder.\n323\t                let prev_grid = builder.grid.clone();\n324\t                let prev_gdt_template = builder.gdt_template;\n325\t                let next_builder = FieldBuilder {\n326\t                    center: builder.center,\n327\t                    subcenter: builder.subcenter,\n328\t                    ref_time: builder.ref_time,\n329\t                    // Preserve grid definition for subsequent fields in multi-field messages\n330\t                    grid: prev_grid,\n331\t                    gdt_template: prev_gdt_template,\n332\t                    ..Default::default()\n333\t                };\n334\t                if let Some(field) = builder.build() {\n335\t                    out.push(field);\n336\t                }\n337\t                builder = next_builder;\n338\t            }\n339\t            _ => { /* Unknown section — skip */ }\n340\t        }\n341\t\n342\t        // Advance buf.pos to the end of this section.\n343\t        buf.pos = sec_start + sec_len;\n344\t    }\n345\t\n346\t    // Consume \"7777\" end marker.\n347\t    let end = &msg[body_end..body_end + 4];\n348\t    if end != b\"7777\" {\n349\t        return Err(Error::TooShort { needed: 4, got: 0 Result<(u16, u16, ReferenceTime)> {\n358\t    let mut b = Buf::new(body);\n359\t    // oct 6-7 of section (indices 0-1 in body): originating center\n360\t    let center = b.read_u16be()?;\n361\t    //    let second = b.read_u8()?;\n372\t    // production status and type of data — not stored in Field currently\n373\t    Ok((\n374\t        center,\n375\t        subcenter,\n376\t        ReferenceTime { year, month, day, hour, minute, second, significance },\n377\t    ))\n378\t}\n379\t\n380\t// ── Section 3: Grid Definition ────────────────────────────────────────────────\n381\t\n382\tfn Dj.                       // oct 21–25: major axis\n624\t    b.skip(1 + 4)?;                       // oct 26–30: minor axis\n625\t\n626\t    let nx = b.read_u32be()?;             // oct 31–34\n627\t    let ny = b.read_u32be()?;             // oct 35–38\n628\t\n629\t    b.skip(4)?;                           // oct 39–42: basic angle\n630\t    b.skip(4)?;                           // oct 43–46: subdivisions\n631\t\n632\t    let lat_first = b.read_latlon_micro()? as f64 / 1_000_000.0; // oct 47–50\n633\t    let lon_first = b.read_longi_micro()? as f64 / 1_000_000.0;  // oct 51–54\n634\t    let resolution_flags = b.read_u8()?;  // oct 55\n635\t    let lat_last  = b.read_latlon_micro()? as f64 / 1_000_000.0; // oct 56–59\n636\t    let lon_last  = b.read_longi_micro()? as f64 / 1_000_000.0;  // oct 60–63\n637\t\n638\t    let di        = b.read_u32be()? as f64 / 1_000_000.0;        // oct 64–67\n639\t    let n_parallels = b.read_u32be()?;                            // oct 68–71 (N, not Dj)\n640\t    let scanning_mode = b.read_u8()?;     // oct 72\n641\t\n642\t    let projection = GridProjection::GaussianLatLon(GaussianLatLonParams { n_parallels });\n643\t\n644\t    Ok(GridDefinition {\n645\t        template: 40,\n646\t        num_data_points,\n647\t        nx,\n648\t        ny,\n649\t        lat_first,\n650\t        lon_first,\n651\t        lat_last,\n652\t        lon_last,\n653\t        di,\n654\t        dj: 0.0,   // not stored in GDT 3.40; N replaces Dj\n655\t        scanning_mode,\n656\t        resolution_flags,\n657\t        shape_of_earth,\n658\t        projection,\n659\t    })\n660\t}\n661\t\n662\t// ── Section 4: Product Definition ────────────────────────────────────────────\n663\t\n664\tfn parse_section4(\n665\t    body: &[u8],\n666\t    discipline: u8,\n667\t) -> Result<(u16, ParameterId, ForecastTime, Level, Option<Ensemble>)> {\n668\t    let mut b = Buf::new(body);\n669\t    let _n_coord = b.read_u16be()?; // oct 6-7: number of coordinate values\n670\t    let template = b.read_u16be()?; // oct 8-9: PDT template number\n671\t\n672\t    match template {\n673\t        0 => {\n674\t            let (param, fore, lvl, ens) = parse_pdt_0(&mut b, discipline)?;\n675\t            Ok((0, param, fore, lvl, ens))\n676\t        }\n677\t        1 => {\n678\t            let (param, fore, lvl, ens) = parse_pdt_1(&mut b, discipline)?;\n679\t            Ok((1, param, fore, lvl, ens))\n680\t        }\n681\t        8 => {\n682\t            let (param, fore, lvl, ens) = parse_pdt_8(&mut b, discipline)?;\n683\t            Ok((8, param, fore, lvl, ens))\n684\t        }\n685\t        11 => {\n686\t            let (param, fore, lvl, ens) = parse_pdt_11(&mut b, discipline)?;\n687\t            Ok((11, param, fore, lvl, ens))\n688\t        }\n689\t        _ => Err(Error::NotImplemented),\n690\t    }\n691\t}\n692\t\n693\t/// Parse the common PDT header fields shared by templates 4.0, 4.1, 4.8, 4.11.\n694\t///\n695\t/// Reads octets 10–34 (parameter, time, and level fields).  The caller reads\n696\t/// any template-specific tail octets after calling this function.\n697\tfn parse_pdt_common_header(\n698\t    b: &mut Buf,\n699\t    discipline: u8,\n700\t) -> Result<(ParameterId, ForecastTime, Level)> {\n701\t    let category = b.read_u8()?;  // oct 10\n702\t    let number = b.read_u8()?;    // oct 11\n703\t    b.skip(1)?; // generating process type (oct 12)\n704\t    b.skip(1)?; // background generating process id (oct 13)\n705\t    b.skip(1)?; // analysis/forecast generating process id (oct 14)\n706\t    b.skip(2)?; // hours of cutoff after reference time (oct 15-16)\n707\t    b.skip(1)?; // minutes of cutoff (oct 17)\n708\t    let time_range_unit = b.read_u8()?;    // oct 18\n709\t    let forecast_offset = b.read_u32be()?; // oct 19-22\n710\t\n711\t    let type1 = b.read_u8()?;                     // oct 23\n712\t    let scale_factor1 = b.read_i8()?;             // oct 24\n713\t    let scaled_value1 = b.read_u32be()? as i32;   // oct 25-28\n714\t\n715\t    let raw_type2 = b.read_u8()?;                     // oct 29\n716\t    let raw_scale_factor2 = b.read_i8()?;             // oct 30\n717\t    let raw_scaled_value2 = b.read_u32be()? as i32;   // oct 31-34\n718\t\n719\t    // When second surface type is 255 (missing), zero out its scale/value\n720\t    // to match eccodes behavior.\n721\t    let (type2, scale_factor2, scaled_value2) = if raw_type2 == 255 {\n722\t        (255u8, 0i8, 0i32)\n723\t    } else {\n724\t        (raw_type2, raw_scale_factor2, raw_scaled_value2)\n725\t    };\n726\t\n727\t    let param = ParameterId { discipline, category, number };\n728\t    // Reference time is filled in from Section 1 by the caller.\n729\t    let fore = ForecastTime {\n730\t        reference_time: ReferenceTime {\n731\t            year: 0, month: 0, day: 0, hour: 0, minute: 0, second: 0, significance: 0,\n732\t        },\n733\t        time_range_unit,\n734\t        forecast_offset,\n735\t    };\n736\t    let lvl = Level { type1, scale_factor1, scaled_value1, type2, scale_factor2, scaled_value2 };\n737\t\n738\t    Ok((param, fore, lvl))\n739\t}\n740\t\n741\t/// Product Definition Template 4.0: Analysis or forecast at horizontal level.\n742\tfn parse_pdt_0(\n743\t    b: &mut Buf,\n744\t    discipline: u8,\n745\t) -> Result<(ParameterId, ForecastTime, Level, Option<Ensemble>)> {\n746\t    let (param, fore, lvl) = parse_pdt_common_header(b, discipline)?;\n747\t    Ok((param, fore, lvl, None))\n748\t}\n749\t\n750\t/// Product Definition Template 4.1: Individual ensemble forecast, control and\n751\t/// perturbed, at a horizontal level at a point in time.\n752\t///\n753\t/// WMO GRIB2 Table 4.1:\n754\t/// - Octs 10–34: common header (same as PDT 4.0)\n755\t/// - Oct 35: type of ensemble forecast (Table 4.6)\n756\t/// - Oct 36: perturbation number\n757\t/// - Oct 37: number of forecasts in ensemble\n758\tfn parse_pdt_1(\n759\t    b: &mut Buf,\n760\t    discipline: u8,\n761\t) -> Result<(ParameterId, ForecastTime, Level, Option<Ensemble>)> {\n762\t    let (param, fore, lvl) = parse_pdt_common_header(b, discipline)?;\n763\t\n764\t    let member_type = b.read_u8()?;          // oct 35: Table 4.6\n765\t    let perturbation_number = b.read_u8()?;  // oct 36\n766\t    let _n_ensemble = b.read_u8()?;          // oct 37: number in ensemble (unused by harness)\n767\t\n768\t    let ens = Ensemble { member_type, number: perturbation_number as i16 };\n769\t    Ok((param, fore, lvl, Some(ens)))\n770\t}\n771\t\n772\t/// Product Definition Template 4.8: Average, accumulation, extreme values or\n773\t/// other statistically-processed values at a horizontal level in a continuous\n774\t/// or non-continuous time interval.\n775\t///\n776\t/// WMO GRIB2 Table 4.8:\n777\t/// - Octs 10–34: common header (same as PDT 4.0)\n778\t/// - Oct 35: year (u16), month, day, hour, minute, second of end of interval\n779\t/// - Oct 41: number of time range specifications (n)\n780\t/// - Octs 42 onward: n × 12-byte time range specifications (skipped)\n781\t///\n782\t/// Only the common header fields are surfaced; the statistical window\n783\t/// information is not yet modelled in `ForecastTime`.\n784\tfn parse_pdt_8(\n785\t    b: &mut Buf,\n786\t    discipline: u8,\n787\t) -> Result<(ParameterId, ForecastTime, Level, Option<Ensemble>)> {\n788\t    let (param, fore, lvl) = parse_pdt_common_header(b, discipline)?;\n789\t\n790\t    // End-of-interval timestamp and time-range specs: skip entirely.\n791\t    // Oct 35-40: end time (year u16 + month + day + hour + min + sec = 7 bytes)\n792\t    b.skip(7)?;\n793\t    // Oct 41: number of time range specs\n794\t    let n_ranges = b.read_u8()? as usize;\n795\t    // Each spec is 12 bytes.\n796\t    b.skip(12 * n_ranges)?;\n797\t\n798\t    Ok((param, fore, lvl, None))\n799\t}\n800\t\n801\t/// Product Definition Template 4.11: Individual ensemble member +\n802\t/// time-processed statistical product at a horizontal level.\n803\t///\n804\t/// WMO GRIB2 Table 4.11:\n805\t/// - Octs 10–34: common header (same as PDT 4.0)\n806\t/// - Oct 35: type of ensemble forecast (Table 4.6)\n807\t/// - Oct 36: perturbation number\n808\t/// - Oct 37: number of forecasts in ensemble\n809\t/// - Oct 38-43: end-of-interval timestamp (year u16 + month + day + hour + min + sec)\n810\t/// - Oct 44: number of time range specifications (n)\n811\t/// - Octs 45+: n × 12-byte time range specs (skipped)\n812\tfn parse_pdt_11(\n813\t    b: &mut Buf,\n814\t    discipline: u8,\n815\t) -> Result<(ParameterId, ForecastTime, Level, Option<Ensemble>)> {\n816\t    let (param, fore, lvl) = parse_pdt_common_header(b, discipline)?;\n817\t\n818\t    let member_type = b.read_u8()?;          // oct 35\n819\t    let perturbation_number = b.read_u8()?;  // oct 36\n820\t    let _n_ensemble = b.read_u8()?;          // oct 37\n821\t\n822\t    // Oct 38-43: end-of-interval timestamp (7 bytes: year u16 + month + day + hour + min + sec)\n823\t    b.skip(7)?;\n824\t    // Oct 44: number of time range specs\n825\t    let n_ranges = b.read_u8()? as usize;\n826\t    b.skip(12 * n_ranges)?;\n827\t\n828\t    let ens = Ensemble { member_type, number: perturbation_number as i16 };\n829\t    Ok((param, fore, lvl, Some(ens)))\n830\t}\n831\t\n832\t// ── Section 5: Data Representation ───────────────────────────────────────────\n833\t\n834\tfn parse_section5(body: &[u8]) -> Result<(u16, PackingInfo, Option<ComplexPackingExtra>, usize)> {\n835\t    let mut b = Buf::new(body);\n836\t    let n_values = b.read_u32be()? as usize; // oct 6-9: number of packed values\n837\t    let template = b.read_u16be()?;           // oct 10-11: DRT template number\n838\t\n839\t    match template {\n840\t        0 => {\n841\t            let packing = parse_drt_common(&mut b)?;\n842\t            Ok((0, packing, None, n_values))\n843\t        }\n844\t        2 => {\n845\t            let (packing, extra) = parse_drt_2(&mut b)?;\n846\t            Ok((2, packing, Some(extra), n_values))\n847\t        }\n848\t        3 => {\n849\t            let (packing, extra) = parse_drt_3(&mut b)?;\n850\t            Ok((3, packing, Some(extra), n_values))\n851\t        }\n852\t        40 => {\n853\t            // Template 5.40: JPEG 2000 data compression — same common header as DRT=0.\n854\t            let packing = parse_drt_common(&mut b)?;\n855\t            Ok((40, packing, None, n_values))\n856\t        }\n857\t        41 => {\n858\t            // Template 5.41: PNG data compression — same common header as DRT=0.\n859\t            let packing = parse_drt_common(&mut b)?;\n860\t            Ok((41, packing, None, n_values))\n861\t        }\n862\t        _ => Err(Error::NotImplemented),\n863\t    }\n864\t}\n865\t\n866\t/// Parse the common packing header shared by DRT templates 0, 2, and 3.\n867\tfn parse_drt_common(b: &mut Buf) -> Result<PackingInfo> {\n868\t    let reference_value = b.read_f32be()?;               // oct 12-15: R\n869\t    let binary_scale_factor = b.read_scale_factor_i16()?; // oct 16-17: E\n870\t    let decimal_scale_factor = b.read_scale_factor_i16()?; // oct 18-19: D\n871\t    let bits_per_value = b.read_u8()?;                   // oct 20: N\n872\t    let original_field_type = b.read_u8()?;              // oct 21\n873\t\n874\t    Ok(PackingInfo {\n875\t        reference_value,\n876\t        binary_scale_factor,\n877\t        decimal_scale_factor,\n878\t        bits_per_value,\n879\t        original_field_type,\n880\t    })\n881\t}\n882\t\n883\t/// Data Representation Template 5.2: Complex packing (no spatial differencing).\n884\tfn parse_drt_2(b: &mut Buf) -> Result<(PackingInfo, ComplexPackingExtra)> {\n885\t    let packing = parse_drt_common(b)?;  // oct 12-21: common header\n886\t\n887\t    b.skip(1)?; // oct 22: group splitting method\n888\t    b.skip(1)?; // oct 23: missing value management (0 = none)\n889\t    b.skip(4)?; // oct 24-27: primary missing value\n890\t    b.skip(4)?; // oct 28-31: secondary missing value\n891\t\n892\t    let n_groups = b.read_u32be()?;              // oct 32-35\n893\t    let ref_group_widths = b.read_u8()?;         // oct 36\n894\t    let bits_group_widths = b.read_u8()?;        // oct 37\n895\t    let ref_group_lengths = b.read_u32be()?;     // oct 38-41\n896\t    let length_increment = b.read_u8()?;         // oct 42\n897\t    let true_last_group_length = b.read_u32be()?; // oct 43-46\n898\t    let bits_scaled_group_lengths = b.read_u8()?; // oct 47\n899\t    // Octets 48-49 (order_spatial_diff, extra_octet_count) are absent in template 5.2.\n900\t\n901\t    Ok((packing, ComplexPackingExtra {\n902\t        n_groups,\n903\t        ref_group_widths,\n904\t        bits_group_widths,\n905\t        ref_group_lengths,\n906\t        length_increment,\n907\t        true_last_group_length,\n908\t        bits_scaled_group_lengths,\n909\t        order_spatial_diff: 0,\n910\t        extra_octet_count: 0,\n911\t    }))\n912\t}\n913\t\n914\t/// Data Representation Template 5.3: Complex packing with spatial differencing.\n915\tfn parse_drt_3(b: &mut Buf) -> Result<(PackingInfo, ComplexPackingExtra)> {\n916\t    let packing = parse_drt_common(b)?;  // oct 12-21: common header\n917\t\n918\t    b.skip(1)?; // oct 22: group splitting method\n919\t    b.skip(1)?; // oct 23: missing value management (0 = none)\n920\t    b.skip(4)?; // oct 24-27: primary missing value\n921\t    b.skip(4)?; // oct 28-31: secondary missing value\n922\t\n923\t    let n_groups = b.read_u32be()?;              // oct 32-35\n924\t    let ref_group_widths = b.read_u8()?;         // oct 36\n925\t    let bits_group_widths = b.read_u8()?;        // oct 37\n926\t    let ref_group_lengths = b.read_u32be()?;     // oct 38-41\n927\t    let length_increment = b.read_u8()?;         // oct 42\n928\t    let true_last_group_length = b.read_u32be()?; // oct 43-46\n929\t    let bits_scaled_group_lengths = b.read_u8()?; // oct 47\n930\t    let order_spatial_diff = b.read_u8()?;       // oct 48\n931\t    let extra_octet_count = b.read_u8()?;        // oct 49\n932\t\n933\t    Ok((packing, ComplexPackingExtra {\n934\t        n_groups,\n935\t        ref_group_widths,\n936\t        bits_group_widths,\n937\t        ref_group_lengths,\n938\t        length_increment,\n939\t        true_last_group_length,\n940\t        bits_scaled_group_lengths,\n941\t        order_spatial_diff,\n942\t        extra_octet_count,\n943\t    }))\n944\t}\n945\t\n946\t// ── Section 6: Bit Map ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n947\t\n948\t/// Parse Section 6 (Bit Map).\n949\t///\n950\t/// Returns `(has_bitmap, bitmap_bytes)`:\n951\t/// - `has_bitmap=false, bitmap_bytes=None` when indicator == 255 (all points present).\n952\t/// - `has_bitmap=true, bitmap_bytes=Some(bytes)` when indicator == 0: one bit per grid\n953\t///   point, MSB-first packed, length = ceil(n_grid_points / 8).\n954\tfn parse_section6(body: &[u8]) -> Result<(bool, Option<Vec<u8>>)> {\n955\t    let mut b = Buf::new(body);\n956\t    let indicator = b.read_u8()?; // oct 6\n957\t    match indicator {\n958\t        255 => Ok((false, None)),\n959\t        0 => {\n960\t            // Remaining bytes are the bitmap (1 bit per grid point, MSB first).\n961\t            let bitmap = body[1..].to_vec();\n962\t            Ok((true, Some(bitmap)))\n963\t        }\n964\t        _ => Err(Error::NotImplemented),\n965\t    }\n966\t}\n967\t\n968\t// ── Bitmap expansion ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n969\t\n970\t/// Expand a vector of packed (present-only) values into a full `n_grid`-length\n971\t/// masked grid using the bitmap.\n972\t///\n973\t/// The bitmap is a packed MSB-first bit array (one bit per grid point). Where\n974\t/// the bit is 1, the next value from `packed` is used; where 0, the grid point\n975\t/// is absent (value = 0.0, present = false). Returns `GridValues::Masked` if\n976\t/// a bitmap is provided and `n_packed < n_grid`, otherwise returns the input\n977\t/// as a `Dense` grid.\n978\tfn expand_bitmap(\n979\t    packed: GridValues,\n980\t    bitmap: &Option<Vec<u8>>,\n981\t    n_grid: usize,\n982\t) -> GridValues {\n983\t    let bm = match bitmap {\n984\t        Some(bm) => bm,\n985\t        None => return packed, // no bitmap — pass through\n986\t    };\n987\t\n988\t    let packed_vals = match packed {\n989\t        GridValues::Dense(v) => v,\n990\t        other => return other, // already masked somehow — pass through\n991\t    };\n992\t\n993\t    if packed_vals.len() == n_grid {\n994\t        // The packed count already matches the grid — no expansion needed.\n995\t        return GridValues::Dense(packed_vals);\n996\t    }\n997\t\n998\t    let mut values = vec![0.0f64; n_grid];\n999\t    let mut present = vec![false; n_grid];\n1000\t    let mut packed_idx = 0usize;\n1001\t\n1002\t    for grid_idx in 0..n_grid {\n1003\t        let byte = grid_idx / 8;\n1004\t        let bit = 7 - (grid_idx % 8); // MSB first\n1005\t        let is_present = byte < bm.len() && (bm[byte] >> bit) & 1 == 1;\n1006\t        if is_present {\n1007\t            if packed_idx < packed_vals.len() {\n1008\t                values[grid_idx] = packed_vals[packed_idx];\n1009\t                packed_idx += 1;\n1010\t            }\n1011\t            present[grid_idx] = true;\n1012\t        }\n1013\t    }\n1014\t\n1015\t    GridValues::Masked { values, present }\n1016\t}\n1017\t\n1018\t// ── Section 7: Data ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n1019\t\n1020\tfn decode_section7(\n1021\t    body: &[u8],\n1022\t    packing: &PackingInfo,\n1023\t    drt: u16,\n1024\t    complex_extra: Option<&ComplexPackingExtra>,\n1025\t    n_points: usize,\n1026\t) -> Result<GridValues> {\n1027\t    if let Some(extra) = complex_extra {\n1028\t        return decode_drt3(body, packing, extra, n_points);\n1029\t    }\n1030\t\n1031\t    if drt == 40 {\n1032\t        #[cfg(feature = \"jpeg2000\")]\n1033\t        return decode_drt40(body, packing, n_points);\n1034\t        #[cfg(not(feature = \"jpeg2000\"))]\n1035\t        return Err(Error::NotImplemented);\n1036\t    }\n1037\t\n1038\t    if drt == 41 {\n1039\t        return decode_drt41(body, packing, n_points);\n1040\t    }\n1041\t\n1042\t    // DRT=0: simple packing.\n1043\t    let r = packing.reference_value as f64;\n1044\t    let e = packing.binary_scale_factor as i32;\n1045\t    let d = packing.decimal_scale_factor as i32;\n1046\t    let two_e = 2f64.powi(e);\n1047\t    let ten_d = 10f64.powi(d);\n1048\t\n1049\t    match packing.bits_per_value {\n1050\t        0 => {\n1051\t            // Constant field: X=0 for all points, so Y = (R + 0) / 10^D = R / 10^D.\n1052\t            let v = r / ten_d;\n1053\t            Ok(GridValues::Dense(vec![v; n_points]))\n1054\t        }\n1055\t        n_bits => {\n1056\t            let packed = unpack_n_bits(body, n_points, n_bits as usize);\n1057\t            // WMO spec: Y × 10^D = R + X × 2^E  →  Y = (R + X × 2^E) / 10^D\n1058\t            let values: Vec<f64> = packed.iter().map(|&x| (r + x as f64 * two_e) / ten_d).collect();\n1059\t            Ok(GridValues::Dense(values))\n1060\t        }\n1061\t    }\n1062\t}\n1063\t\n1064\t/// Decode Template 5.40: JPEG 2000 data compression.\n1065\t///\n1066\t/// Section 7 contains a JPEG 2000 codestream (J2K) or JP2 container. The first\n1067\t/// component carries packed integers X; decoded values follow: Y = (R + X × 2^E) / 10^D.\n1068\t#[cfg(feature = \"jpeg2000\")]\n1069\tfn decode_drt40(body: &[u8], packing: &PackingInfo, n_points: usize) -> Result<GridValues> {\n1070\t    let img = jpeg2k::Image::from_bytes(body)\n1071\t        .map_err(|_| Error::InvalidData(\"JPEG2000 decode failed\"))?;\n1072\t    let comp = img.components().first()\n1073\t        .ok_or(Error::InvalidData(\"J2K: no image components\"))?;\n1074\t\n1075\t    let r = packing.reference_value as f64;\n1076\t    let e = packing.binary_scale_factor as i32;\n1077\t    let d = packing.decimal_scale_factor as i32;\n1078\t    let two_e = 2f64.powi(e);\n1079\t    let ten_d = 10f64.powi(d);\n1080\t\n1081\t    let data = comp.data(); // &[i32] — raw packed integer X values\n1082\t    let values: Vec<f64> = data.iter()\n1083\t        .take(n_points)\n1084\t        .map(|&x| (r + x as f64 * two_e) / ten_d)\n1085\t        .collect();\n1086\t\n1087\t    if values.len() < n_points {\n1088\t        return Err(Error::InvalidData(\"J2K: fewer pixels than grid points\"));\n1089\t    }\n1090\t\n1091\t    Ok(GridValues::Dense(values))\n1092\t}\n1093\t\n1094\t/// Decode Template 5.41: PNG data compression.\n1095\t///\n1096\t/// Section 7 contains a raw PNG image. Pixel values are packed integers X;\n1097\t/// decoded grid values follow the standard formula: Y = (R + X × 2^E) / 10^D.\n1098\t/// Only 8-bit and 16-bit grayscale PNGs are supported (the common GRIB2 case).\n1099\tfn decode_drt41(body: &[u8], packing: &PackingInfo, n_points: usize) -> Result<GridValues> {\n1100\t    let cursor = std::io::Cursor::new(body);\n1101\t    let decoder = png::Decoder::new(cursor);\n1102\t    let mut reader = decoder.read_info().map_err(|_| Error::InvalidData(\"PNG header decode failed\"))?;\n1103\t\n1104\t    let buf_size = reader.output_buffer_size().ok_or(Error::InvalidData(\"PNG: buffer size unknown\"))?;\n1105\t    let mut img_data = vec![0u8; The key savings vs. the\n1304\t/// per-element path:\n1305\t///\n1306\t/// * No `div_ceil` per element — `bytes_needed` is computed once on pre-fill.\n1307\t/// * No inner byte-assembly loop per element — bytes are amortised over a\n1308\t///   window: one byte loaded per 8 bits consumed on average.\n1309\t/// * Single `shift + mask` per value instead of 3–9 byte-load + shift operations.\n1310\t///\n1311\t/// The left-aligned invariant: valid bits always occupy the MSB positions of\n1312\t/// `buf`, so the next `w`-bit value is always extracted as `(buf >> (64 - w)) & mask`.\n1313\t///\n1314\t/// # Panics (debug only)\n1315\t/// `w` must satisfy `0 < w ≤ 32`. from `data` starting at `bit_offset` (MSB-first).\n1382\tfn read_bits_at(data: &[u8], bit_offset: usize, n_bits: usize) -> u64 {\n1383\t    if n_bits == 0 {\n1384\t        return 0;\n1385\t mask\n1399\t}\n1400\t\n1401\t/// Extract `count` unsigned integers each `n_bits` wide from `data`.\n1402\t/// Bits are packed MSB-first: the first value occupies bits [0..n_bits-1]\n1403\t/// of the
